title: Imagined melody identification
disposition_reason: The delivered source is a complete closed-set instructed-excerpt comparison, narrower than subjective imagined-melody identification. Preparation/constructor source works toward delivery but does not establish authentic inference or a direct observation arm.

scientific_target.question: Can a model infer the instructed excerpt class from a fixed no-concurrent-audio EEG window of an excluded participant, with performance beyond a matched zero-waveform control?
scientific_target.known_answer: The instructed excerpt identifier in canonical class order[1,2,3,4,11,12,13,14,21,22,23,24]; it is not a verified report of the participant’s subjective melody content.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source condition 4 event/annotation identities, privately joined to admitted physical EEG windows and complete support. Authentic physical-boundary validation remains external.
scientific_target.case_unit: Exactly one current EEG window [64,512], float32 volts at 128 Hz, representing four seconds beginning 0.5 s after source onset.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Ten biological participants; multiple excerpt/repetition trials are nested and LOPO training folds overlap.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Closed-set cross-person instruction decoding under the source’s fixed imagery protocol, with every class in training. The paired EEG/ZERO contrast tests dependence on waveforms without separating neural activity from ocular/motor/cue carryover.
exclusions: No unseen-excerpt generalization or verified introspective-content decoding.
No pure melody/imagery causal inference; lyrics/nonlyrics variants are separate classes, not 12 unique melodies.
No direct/native reasoning gain inferred from computational programme or interactive tool results.

inputs: Complete64-channel source-ordered windows after within-sample average reference and fixed four-sample averaging 512 Hz→128 Hz; no outside-window padding or fitted session preprocessing is added.

All permitted labeled training windows from other nine participants, opaque group aliases and four sealed reference states for the current fold/view. ZERO replaces all training/query waveforms with positive float32 zeros while retaining support and labels.
forbidden_inputs: Held-person labeled calibration, other query windows or query batches, prior conversations, cross-query state, target correctness and grading feedback.
Source event timestamps/names, excerpt-coded cues, actual concurrent audio, unrestricted retrieval and model updates shared across episodes.
observation_contract.case_identity: Canonical IDs privately bind source-event index/onset and participant; candidates receive opaque 32 hex row/group aliases and the exact 12 nonconsecutive class IDs. The complete trial census N is source-dependent and not fabricated here.
observation_contract.split: Leave one participant out; train on the other nine. Every admitted condition 4 trial and all 12 classes per participant are required; current-query unlabeled transduction is allowed for candidates but fixed references remain inductive.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete10-person support, two waveform views and three replications; all 12 N candidate closures and 240 complete assessment panels are required. Source preparation maps 105 exact prerequisites; N and authentic eligibility are not established by constructor success.

primary.name: Participant-macro 12-class balanced accuracy
primary.aggregation: Compute12 class recalls within each of 10 people, average equally across classes and people; report paired I-minus-F and EEG-minus-ZERO separately.
primary.rationale: Weights people and classes equally while preserving the true instruction-label target and mandatory no-waveform comparator.

secondary: Participant-macro NLL with declared 1e-12 log floor; retain probability validation without renormalization.
Complete per-class confusion/recall, paired mode/view contrasts, reference comparisons and three-replication range/sample SD.
Leave-one-person aggregation sensitivity, not retraining or population confidence intervals.

comparators.name: BP_LDA, TM_LDA and RBF_KRR
comparators.inputs: The same complete permitted training windows and group structure for each view.
comparators.procedure: Existing source completes all training-person-held inner settings and temperature selection; strongest family chosen solely from training.

comparators.name: Historical BP_LDA plus uniform and Laplace priors
comparators.inputs: Historical declared training recipe or training class counts only.
comparators.procedure: Existing source preserves historical algorithm as a distinct comparator without claiming numerical parity; analytic priors expose class-frequency shortcuts.

comparators.name: ZERO waveform view
comparators.inputs: Identical labels/group/protocol/budgets but all-zero waveforms in both train and query.
comparators.procedure: Independent reference fitting and both candidate modes run on full unchanged support; no EEG-fitted state transfers to ZERO.

nuisance_controls: Fixed equal-duration crop removes excerpt-length leakage; authenticate imagery cue/audio boundaries rather than trusting synthetic feedback pseudo-times.
Exclude event markers/filename/order and held-person calibration; enforce fresh single-query state.
Retain all source channels/trials including original bad-channel flags; report flag prevalence after closure.
Disclose candidate current-query transduction versus inductive reference access and cue/perception/ocular/motor alternatives.
evaluation.uncertainty: Ten fixed people and overlapping LOPO folds support descriptive paired biological effects. Report omission sensitivity and algorithm-replication variation; do not use iid-trial significance or interpret repetitions as people.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require exactly 12 finite[0,1]probabilities summing within 1e-6; no renormalization. Every class/person/view/replication and all 240 panels must close before targets open; incomplete support or unknown closure refuses complete assessment.

implementation.scorer_target: The scorer evaluates held instruction labels from real EEG windows, not source-paper table reproduction. It computes balanced accuracy/log loss and matched waveform/mode contrasts; it cannot verify what music was actually imagined.
implementation.delivered_scope: Portable constructor, exact source-map preparer, candidate protocol and full protected scorer are public. This is a source instance construction path, with authentic input and independent runtime/physical qualification outstanding.
missing: Validate source FIF/events/physical imagery windows and complete 10-person class support.
Qualify exact numerical dependencies and complete fixed-reference fits.
Provision enforced per-query isolation and actual provider/native transport before any mode comparison.
implementation.execution_evidence: Current-checkout source-preparation and construction controls are documented; they use source and invented metadata profiles, not authentic neural inference or solver trials.

direct_observation.representation: A fixed 64 channel four-second waveform can support a no-tools numerical/visual observation condition with the same 12-label answer.
direct_observation.boundary: Any direct arm must receive a bounded declared observation and its own matched demonstrations, without numerical/model calls or held labels; programme evidence cannot stand in.
missing: No no-tools packet/renderer and direct-model transport or trial evidence.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed time/channel waveform inspection preserving the fixed four-second observation and label schema.
typed_viewer.boundary: A viewer must restrict rendering/actions and never return raw arrays, private event identities or other queries.
missing: No task-specific typed viewer or audited image transport.

tool_assisted.representation: episodes.investigate implements the provider/python/predict action loop, candidate_runner.execute runs each numerical action, and the study controller collects the complete case result; these are source capabilities without authentic/runtime qualification.
tool_assisted.boundary: At most declared native actions within matched episode resources; current-query transduction permitted, all state reset and no feedback.
missing: Authentic full input and enforced provider/native isolation qualification.

frozen_program.representation: episodes.author seals predict(context) before authentic exposure; episodes.fixed and candidate_runner.execute implement one no-provider native invocation per query with the same permitted observations and numerical toolkit.
frozen_program.boundary: One native invocation per current query under declared matched budgets; precommitted algorithm may use permitted single-query transduction.
missing: Complete reference fits and independently qualified physical execution.
